extracted.name: Baked Pumpkin Bread
extracted.description: This baked pumpkin bread recipe features buttermilk for a moist, tender crumb and cinnamon, brown sugar, and nutmeg for irresistible fall flavor.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg into a bowl; mix well. Stir in pumpkin, brown sugar, buttermilk, egg, and butter until well blended. Pour batter into a 9x5-inch loaf pan; smooth the top.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 1 hour.
